answer: Because the lagoon release is logged with every signature, the gale audit publishes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the ember graph and each risks its bond. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
